# Maurício Yokoyama Issei

**Tech Lead | Systems Analysis Specialist**

---

## Professional Summary

Systems Analysis Specialist with **over 20 years** of experience in software development, technical leadership, integration of platforms and solving complex problems.

**Main Expertise:** Salesforce, AWS, REST/SOAP APIs, Observability (Datadog, Splunk), SRE, and Java development, Node.js, Python, Go and .NET.

Certificate **SRE**, with specialisations in **Data Science**, **Business Agility**, **AWS** and **AI Agency Design Patterns**. I combine deep technical knowledge with strategic vision to manage complex projects and lead high performance teams.

Recognized for creating collaborative environments, delivering robust solutions and generating measurable impact on organizations. In love with challenges that combine technical expertise, business vision and agile practices.

# Success Cases - STAR Methodology

Practical examples of projects and technical challenges solved throughout the career, organized by the methodology **STAR** (Situation, Task, Action, Result).

---

## 2025

### Commercial Automatic Pipe

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

The executive's work list did not have an intelligent prioritization to optimize the planning time of the day and the goal to be met by the executive.

**Tasks:**
- Discovery and implementation of quick feasibility solution to meet pain and evaluate the planning model and methodology

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Designed outline solution to process prioritization intelligence in Salesforce itself with scheduled batch processes

**Impact (Result)**

- **Increase of more than 15%** in the achievement of the goals
- Agility in scheduling and customer service

**🛠️ Stack:** Salesforce

---

## 2024

### Commercial Grouping Project

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

- Legacy automations had a process with **SLA up to 10 days** to effect the contract fee for the client
- Failure process with many manual dependencies
- No validation of the arrangement of the group participants

**Tasks:**
- Discovery and design of a technical solution to enable modernization
- Development of participant arrangement validation application

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Implemented and refined solution for implementation of the new Commercial Group with the team

**Impact (Result)**

- Modernization of the process with validation and effectiveness **in bid time** ( 10 days reduction to real time)

**🛠️ Stack:** Java 

---

### Machine Time Delivery Project by the Executive

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

It was only delivered the machine after opening process of Order of Service which was attended only by technicians.

**Tasks:**
- Enable solution to validate the commercial service model where a new machine auto boot technology was used in the act of the proposal

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Implementing in the first half of 2024 a **MVP** for validation of the model
- Implemented in the second semester definitive architecture to choose the type of technology and quantity that can be delivered on time by commercial

**Impact (Result)**

- Speed and activation targets in the act of Accreditation

**🛠️ Stack:** Salesforce 

---

### Implementation of Likert on Days

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

No business day evaluation data.

**Tasks:**
- Facilitate the capture of the journey satisfaction information in a controlled and reusable way by other journeys

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Designed technical solution to standardize the capture and validation of eligibility for capture of the search
- Prepared POC in Quicksight analytical follow-up report

**Impact (Result)**

- Visibility and creation of **Satisfaction OKR** the journeys

**🛠️ Stack:** Quicksight 

---

## 2023

### WF Callback Accreditation Status Update

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

- After sending proposals by the executive, the executive needed to consult the status to see if the proposal was effective or had any problems
- For cases that had a problem there were no details that would guide the executive on what to do, requiring the opening of incident by the executive for analysis and orientation or treatment of the proposal
- High volume of incidents and problems of proposals stopped, pending processing (status C)

**Tasks:**
- Implement service that receives the return of proposal status, which is sent by WF after processing
- Mapping the main reasons for proposals that were stopped by errors or failures
- Refining root cause solutions for identified problems

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Implemented service **WF callback** for TV2
- Open stories and prioritized root cause corrections of the proposals problems

**Impact (Result)**

- Rapid feedback on the situation of the proposal for executives
- Prioritization of root cause corrections of validations and problems that left the proposal pending

**🛠️ Stack:** Salesforce 

---

## 2022

### PJ Current Account Opening by Cockpit Rede

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

Project with experimentation bias of the commercial model of Rede to give autonomy to the Executive to initiate the opening of Current Account Itaú PJ in Cockpit Rede itself.

**Tasks:**
- Participation of technical refinements
- Screen development and integrations
- Monitoring of deployments and validations
- Review and refactoring of integrations
- Discovery for MVP evolution
- Attendance of incidents

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- In the pilot's follow-up, point improvements in the MVP were identified to increase the number of executives who experienced the solution.
- Improved integration logs and monitoring for quick identification of problems or divergences

**Impact (Result)**

- Stable solution and provided scaling for most executives to use
- With adjustments of the care model, the process was shortened and the bank manager did not need to act, giving more autonomy to the executive

**🛠️ Stack:** Salesforce  Rede | Itaú PJ | APIs

---

### Accreditation Evolution Projects in the Standard Plan

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

The accreditation in the standard plane was treated in a different flow of screens with specific information, integrations and filling. The main needs of the commercial area were opened in **Three great epics:**
- Sending more than one machine in the Standard Plan Accreditation
- Sending more than one technology in Standard Plan Accreditation
- Validation of Flex hiring eligibility in Standard Plan Accreditation

**Tasks:**
- Implement in the flow of the standard plane the filling of the amount of machines per type of technology
- Implement the same Ipricing Flex hire eligibility query
- Homologize all integrations until Service Orders and PV generation

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Refined needs and elaborated a short delivery strategy of simple implementation and in parallel the discovery of total absorption of the flow of the standard plan within the trading process of Ipricing 2.0
- Initially the possibility was given only to inform more than one machine for a single technology
- It was delivered following the unified journey of Ipricing 2.0 considering as the standard offer options, with or without Flex depending on eligibility and also with the possibility to choose more than one type of technology and also inform more than one machine per technology in the proposal

**Impact (Result)**

- Optimization of the logistic operation, managing to perform in **D0** in most cases the complete delivery of the proposal made by the commercial
- Optimization of the Executive operational that does not need to open new machine requests after the proposal
- Executive informs the customer correctly in hiring time if it has the anticipation in D2
- Agility in the delivery of demands, with the **3 great epics solved in two strategic deliveries**
- Standardization of the trading day without the need for two squads to take care of Cockpit Accreditation

**🛠️ Stack:** Salesforce 

---

### Accreditation Physical Person

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

- Commercial executives only had the option of accreditation of Physical Person with standard plan by sending by email the PCAE form to the service center that sent the proposal
- Only after the implementation of PV and updating data in Salesforce (D+2) could the executive renegotiate fees for PF client in Ipricing 2.0

**Tasks:**
- Development of a new flow to PF
- Approval of integrations
- Implementation with wave expansion strategy, with monitoring and validation of each new proposal

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Seeked to develop a flow of composite screens with 'functional' features in Salesforce (low-code) and with more specialized micro screen components
- Support in parallel of another epic involved to simplify and reduce registration data of the accreditation proposal

**Impact (Result)**

- Deliver day in Cockpit integrated with Ipricing trading, with all features already evolved from PJ as requests for more than one machine and more than one technology, Flex eligibility, offers and price trading

**🛠️ Stack:** Salesforce 

---

### Validation of the Banking House in the Canal

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

The need to validate in time to fill out a proposal if Itaú's banking home data are valid with an account suitable for receiving payments.

**Tasks:**
- Draw integration architecture
- Refine with UX how to treat validations
- Integrated approval with GE square

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Integration between TV2 and GE1 has been implemented in the AWS layer, and only TV2 is responsible for the integration with Salesforce that triggers the consultation.

**Impact (Result)**

- Project implemented in phases, with controlled pilot audience, with validation and gradual monitoring of each phase, being made total expansion after much validation with executives and implementations of improvements
- Validation with dynamic business rule being the GE1 responsible for determining whether it is an impediment return or that accepts the home with the guidance messages
- Small reduction in cases of bank suspension of customers Itaú. Discovered that the situation that makes the account fit for receipt is not summed up in a status

**🛠️ Stack:** AWS 

---

### WhatsApp Accreditation Formalization Upload

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

Sending the link to the client to formalize the PJ accreditation proposal is only performed by email.

**Tasks:**
- Integration architecture between TV2, QI1 and EP8 of Itaú via internal environment
- Authentication of the Itaú service via STS
- Release of routes, security rules and application registrations in Itaú
- Condition functionality for pilot controlled audience
- Project correlated with formalization developments that aims to give more clarity to the client than is being contracted

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Designed and aligned an internal integration architecture between AWS Rede and internal bank Gateway
- Registered consumer applications in the bank’s STS and Gateway
- Due to the lack of technical team and prioritization by the quad of the acronym IQ1, all development of the acronym part of the form of **innersource**
- Integration developed with parameterized configurations to enable reuse by other channels

**Impact (Result)**

- Pilot in production worked well, but was pivoted due to the correlation of this project with the improvements of formalization that were not well accepted by executives and with lack of automated processes that depended on an operational performance of the IT team to carry out proposals that had no interaction of the client and also on formalization of cluster proposals that it was not coherent to send values and conditions that would not be effective to the client after the processes of grouping and equating fees

**🛠️ Stack:** AWS 

---

## 2021

### Discovery for Sybase ASE Corp IP Change

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

To segregate non-PCI PCI networks, a project was opened to evaluate the change in the IP of the server of the corporate Sybase ASE ( GE1, WF1, WM1, etc.) and it was necessary to map and estimate all applications and services that needed to be adjusted.

**Tasks:**
- Find, map and estimate effort to maintain each application or service

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Search for versioned fonts
- Analysis of the settings of each application/service
- Survey how to test each application and service
- Apply and test under approval the change

**Impact (Result)**

- Project was depriorized after initial high impact estimate on a very large volume of applications and services still in survey
- The infrastructure team presented another solution that would not need to change the current IP
- Mapping and understanding of the support team on many legacy applications

**🛠️ Stack:** Sybase 

---

### New Integrated Community Model Onboarding and Build&Run

Integration of project teams with support teams, being necessary to include in the routine of the project team processes of call, shift, monitoring and governance of the productive environment.

**Tasks:**
- Document Support Backlog
- Empower project team in incident care

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Follow-up in pairs with dev and support in incident care and on shift
- Pass of knowledge on recurrent productive problems

**Impact (Result)**

- Times with delivery routines and support in relay of 'beater' and timer

**🛠️ Stack:** Agile

## 2020

### Budget Review and CINVEST of the New Salesforce Contract

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

With the maturity of Salesforce's first contract and significant expansion of tool users, the team did not know how the types of licenses were priced and did not have a historical basis for the individual acquisitions that had already been made and needed to close a very conservative budget.

**Tasks:**
- Meetings with Salesforce to detail each type of license
- Review of all planned features and needs
- Align with each area number of users and expansion expectations
- Set license limits management

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Spread all costs at the lowest level of detail
- Prepared presentation and defense for CINVEST
- Detailed for each team as the budget was composed

**Impact (Result)**

- **Economy of more than 3MM** in the negotiation of the final contract
- New contract negotiated in partnership with CoE Salesforce of Itaú and purchasing team
- Clearness of areas on the cost of each type of license

**🛠️ Stack:** Salesforce 

---

### Supplier Budget Review (MGI Tech & Maplink)

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

Lack of clarity and knowledge about the pricing of what was already in use in the production and the estimates of expansion of the areas to prepare the IT budget.

**Tasks:**
- Alignment with each supplier to clarify pricing
- Alignment with Logistics and Commercial areas on underutilized resources and expansion planning
- Elaboration of new conditions and requirements for new contracts

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Planned and built presentation and defense for CINVEST
- Canceled hiring tablet rental for commercials
- Reviewed and updated the version of rented mobile phones for Logistics technicians
- Separated from the supplier's equipment and resources contract, the service contract

**Impact (Result)**

- **Economy of approximately 500 k** in renegotiated contracts
- Better budget management of suppliers

**🛠️ Stack:** Contract Management 

---

### Support Core Rede (GE1, WF1, WM1, etc.)

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

With much quieter Sales Force support, the support with the systems was unified Core Rede of WF1, GE1, etc., with the need and goals to reduce the number of calls, abends, time of incident attendance and direction of root cause corrections for project teams.

**Tasks:**
- Analysis of so-called critics in need of quick palliative solutions
- Specification of Root Cause Improvements
- Development of improvements and corrections
- Validation and monitoring of project deployments
- Monitoring of project refinements with support bias, prioritizing with teams non-functional monitoring, safety and quality requirements

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Service to calls of various problems (Cadastrals, Accreditation, Banking, Product Qualification, Structural Projects, etc.)
- Log improvements
- Included integrations to capture logs in Splunk
- Support team training with knowledge of Salesforce

**Impact (Result)**

- Achievement of targets for reducing incidents and time of call attendance
- Reduction of batch mesh abends
- Support team with training also in Salesforce

**🛠️ Stack:** Splunk

- Execution of implementation Runbooks in production and monitoring of validations
- Direction for the team of improvement projects and root cause treatatives of incidents

**Impact (Result)**

- Rapid incident response
- Reduction of critical problems for commercial operation
- Largest number of project team quality deliveries

**🛠️ Stack:** Salesforce 

---

## 2018

### Transition of the Support Team

**Challenge (Situation/Task)**

Cockpit and Campo Force projects, recently deployed in production, without a well-defined process of support and change, with a high volume of errors and complaints.

**Tasks:**
- Analyze and target incomplete errors, failures and features
- Align versioning, change and deployment processes
- Implement monitoring
- Treat incidents

**⚡ Minha Atuação (Ação)**

- Aligned and created a stream of support calls for commercial executives and logistics technicians and managers
- Aligned with the area of change and information security, the support team's responsibility is to validate and implement the deployments of the teams in Salesforce centrally
- Aligned with best practice teams for versioning and using development Sandboxes
- Specified and prioritized along with Salesforce development plant root cause corrections for productive problems
- Lined up with CMR team monitoring and alarms

**Impact (Result)**

- Reduction and stability of the Salesforce environment for both the Sales Force and the Field Force
- Extension of the number of executives and technicians using the tools
- Higher focus and number of project deliveries by project teams

**🛠️ Stack:** Salesforce 

===Initiation===

# Content — Maurício Yokoyama Issei

> Markdown (GEO/AEO) version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/catalogo>. Author: **Maurício Yokoyama Issei** · en-BR · Published: 2026-01-15 · Updated: 2026-11-11.

## How the contents are organized

By theme, the theme with more content for the less. Each content appears once, in its main theme, with nature (Experience, Study, Proposal, Experiment or Reference). In the end, the author's career and the channel videos.

## Agentic engineering

How to design, orchestrate and take to production AI agents: protocols, memory, tools and the engineer's work next to them.

- [Vibe Coding with Devin](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/devin) — *Study.* Agentic engineering in practice: Devin as an executor of engineering tasks, from intention to code.
- [Auditable AI architecture](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/apresentacao) — *Reference.* GraphRAG, Spec-Driven Development and DevOps Salesforce in two readings of the same truth: the executive, measured at risk and return; the engineering, in coverage and latency.
- [Trust Engineering](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/engenharia-confianca) — *Study.* From Intention to Agentic execution: four modules that connect Reverse Engineering, Agent Engineering and Vibe Coding — from the chaos of AI-as-magic to the governance of AI-as-engineering.
- [AI Agent Engineering](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/engenharia-agentes-ia) — *Study.* The ten principles that make AI systems reliable: little AI on the critical path, contracts, FinOps and Agent-Driven governance.
- [Deterministic Grounding](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/develop-engineering) — *Study.* How to anchor context, restrict actions and validate agent changes in software without confusing a green result with global correction.
- [Agent Ready](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/agent-ready) — *Experience.* How to make a website readable, findable and usable by AI agents: Link headers, Markdown negotiated, Content Signals, API Catalog, MCP and Agent Skills — with the real code of this domain.
- [Case Agents](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/case-agents) — *Experience.* Queries routing and secure selection of tools in a banking agent: 4-layer pre-execution barrier and Silent Crash control.
- [Knowledge OS Enterprise](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/knowledge-os-presentation) — *Proposal.* The knowledge system that gives AI traceability and security: faster decisions without losing control.
- [Agentic Digital Workplace](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/digital-workplace-agentico) — *Study.* As a corporate portal evolves from a list of links to a platform that solves intentions: five stages of maturity, layered architecture, AG-UI, delegated identity, governed knowledge and roadmap.

They also address this theme: [From execution to orchestration of work](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/da-execucao-a-orquestracao), [Structured Conversational Specification](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/especificacao-conversacional), [Boutique Empresarial](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/boutique-empresarial-showcase), [DevOps Salesforce](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/devops-salesforce), [Reverse Engineering Assisted by AI](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/proposta-engenharia-reversa), [SocialSelling](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/socialselling).

Articles and videos of this theme: https://mauricio.issei.com.br/temas/engenharia-agentica

## Management and strategy

Management, strategy and career: what works in companies and what changes with AI.

- [Navigating in Complexity](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/know) — *Study.* The Cynefin Framework and the end of best practices: how to lead innovation and emerging processes in complex environments.
- [Problem Formulation](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/formulacao-de-problemas) — *Study.* Formular is uncertainty reduction engineering — and it needs to stop: six uncertainties, six states of knowledge, stop rule and the hyper-resolution penaltyr.
- [From execution to orchestration of work](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/da-execucao-a-orquestracao) — *Study.* An audio about AI and work, with review of 56 statements: what evidence sustains, what to correct while listening and three scenarios.

They also address this theme: [The Invisible Artificer](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/artifice), [Operation Cognitive Capital](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/operacao-capital-cognitivo), [Knowledge OS Enterprise](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/knowledge-os-presentation), [Agentic Digital Workplace](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/digital-workplace-agentico), [Service Operations 2.0](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/service-operations-2-0).

Articles and videos of this theme: https://mauricio.issei.com.br/temas/gestao-e-estrategia

## Specification and development

Specification-driven development, software architecture patterns, and documentation that people and AI can use.

- [Structured Conversational Specification](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/especificacao-conversacional) — *Proposal.* A workflow proposed to use AI in eliciting requirements under human authority, with traceable divergences between documentation, testing and code — and what has not yet been evaluated.
- [Boutique Empresarial](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/boutique-empresarial-showcase) — *Experience.* Showcase of static architecture MPA, SDD methodology, multi-model agentic pipeline and deterministic Quality Gate behind a real project.

They also address this theme: [Auditable AI architecture](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/apresentacao), [Deterministic Grounding](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/develop-engineering), [Agent Ready](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/agent-ready), [Agent DevOps for Salesforce](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/salesforce-agentic-dev).

Articles and videos of this theme: https://mauricio.issei.com.br/temas/especificacao-e-desenvolvimento

## Salesforce and sales

Salesforce, RevOps and architectures for sales, marketing and customer relationship.

- [DevOps Salesforce](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/devops-salesforce) — *Reference.* Agentic continuous delivery: Hybrid architecture uniting Flosum governance, GitHub flexibility and AI speed in the Salesforce ecosystem.
- [Reverse Engineering Assisted by AI](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/proposta-engenharia-reversa) — *Proposal.* System Transformation Salesforce legacy via AI: from inherited code to live specification without manual refactor.
- [Quick Start: Salesforce + Devin + Flosum](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/salesforce-agentic-quickstart) — *Reference.* Step by step to set up the agentic development environment and perform the first deploy governed in record time.
- [Agent DevOps for Salesforce](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/salesforce-agentic-dev) — *Reference.* Spec-Driven Development training portal and autonomous agents for efficient and non-technical development.
- [SocialSelling](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/socialselling) — *Experiment.* Project overview and good practice model for social sales enhanced by AI agents.

Articles and videos of this theme: https://mauricio.issei.com.br/temas/salesforce-e-vendas

## Cloud and reliability

AWS, infrastructure as code, serverless and reliability engineering that keeps standing systems in production.

- [From Chaos to Resilience](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/sustentacao) — *Reference.* Supporting production systems: critical incident management, reliability (SRE) and effective communication in crisis.
- [Service Operations 2.0](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/service-operations-2-0) — *Proposal.* Executive vision of the Manchester Protocol applied to IT, for systemic resilience and protection of commercial billing.
- [RES observability for Mobility](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/proposta-observabilidade-mobile) — *Proposal.* Smart correlation between devices, network and applications using Datadog and Azure.

Articles and videos of this theme: https://mauricio.issei.com.br/temas/cloud-e-confiabilidade

## Learning and mind

Metacognition, learning, focus and functioning of the mind, applied to study and work.

- [Capacity Before Access](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/capacidade-antes-do-acesso) — *Study.* Teacher competence, pedagogical mediation and governance of the AI in early childhood education and initial fundamental — necessity, sufficiency and conditionality tested.
- [Curiosity and Research](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/curiosidade-e-investigacao) — *Study.* Information is not knowledge, access is not understanding, recognizing is not mastering: how to transform curiosity into research using AI as a bench, not as an oracle.
- [The Self-regulated Learning Cycle](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/aprendizagem-autorregulada) — *Study.* From abstract to new question: what science proves about recovery, spacing and self-explanation, with a protocol of 45–60 minutes and study form. Full version: [From summary to new question](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/aprendizagem-autorregulada-artigo).

Articles and videos of this theme: https://mauricio.issei.com.br/temas/aprendizagem-e-mente

Science, AI history, quantum computing and the ideas behind technology.
